input: Find arts, crafts, music, theater and dance summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Hendersonville, Flat Rock, Etowah, Horse Shoe, Laurel Park, Zirconia and Saluda, NC (Henderson County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Hendersonville summer camps 2026 art theater dance music
"Arts Council of Henderson County" summer camp 2026

candidates.name: Flat Rock Playhouse
candidates.note: 2026 acting and musical-theatre camps for rising K–12, including a Footloose production camp.

candidates.name: Arts Council of Henderson County
candidates.note: 2026 Rhythm & Hues summer arts camp combined visual art, music and dance for ages 6–12.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps included Art-tastic Creations, with painting, sculpture and mixed media.

candidates.name: Relevé Performing Arts Center
candidates.note: Summer dance camps and classes; 2026 camp offerings appeared in local school flyers.

candidates.name: Camp Highlander
candidates.note: Overnight camp with pottery, woodworking, painting, drama, jewelry and dance; summer 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: 2026 day and overnight programs included arts and crafts; also runs Barnabas special-needs camps.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Runs Camp Kanuga, Camp Bob and summer day camps; 2025 day sessions included crafts and music.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish overnight camp operating in 2026, with ceramics, jewelry, musical theatre, dance and guitar.

candidates.name: Camp Greystone
candidates.note: Girls' overnight camp; 2026 activities included drama productions, dance, choral singing and guitar.

candidates.name: Camp Glen Arden
candidates.note: Girls' overnight camp with 2026 sessions and pottery, weaving, woodcarving, drama, dance and ukulele.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys' overnight camp; 2025 arts programming included pottery and three-dimensional craft projects.

candidates.name: Camp Pinewood
candidates.note: Overnight camp with arts and crafts among its activities; summer 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah
candidates.note: Girls' residential summer camp with dance among more than 40 activities; documented in 2026.

candidates.name: Talisman Camps
candidates.note: 2026 overnight programs for neurodivergent children and teens included arts and crafts.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: 2026 overnight sessions included embroidery, tie-dye and other arts-and-crafts activities.
